title: GUEST
author: Minati Pradhan
text:
‎Ding-Dong!
‎The bell rang.
‎
‎The excited little girl in me
‎opened the door,
‎welcomed the guest blissfully.
‎
‎I showed him around my home-
‎my beautifully curated garden,
‎the azure blue sky from my breezy balcony,
‎floating white clouds bidding goodbye slowly,
‎the chirping of the neighbour's parakeet,
‎golden rays of tender sunlight.
‎
‎Alas! The guest had to go.
‎I wanted him to stay a little longer.
‎His presence was invaluable to me.
‎Happiness promised he would visit often.
‎
‎I stared at him long, before shutting the door.
‎
‎Again-  Ding-Dong!
‎I peeped through the hole.
‎It was another guest,
‎unwanted.
‎
‎I ran to the bedroom,
‎covered myself with the quilt,
‎pretended to sleep,
‎shut my eyes tight,
‎increased the volume of my music pad.
‎
‎The continuous bell was hard to ignore.
‎I allowed him inside.
‎He entered, roamed around, and left
‎without my entertaining.
‎
‎I wished he never comes back.
‎But I was pretty sure he would.
‎
‎That sadness -
‎without my hospitality,
‎without my attention,
‎would go back on its own.
Definitely!
